title: 第912章 陈归尘入瓮第911章 夜尘注意你的身份
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
炎璃公主心中，其实并不排斥姜夜。
甚至可以说。
这位姜族神子给她留下的印象，远比她最开始预料的要好。
修为强大。
无论是言谈举止，还是面对魔界诸多强者时的从容，都让炎璃感受到了一种与众不同的气度。
魔族向来崇尚强者。
炎璃更是如此。
她本身性格便直率果断，向来不喜欢那些虚伪的试探与扭捏。
姜夜既然有意，她也并不觉得反感。
反而觉得，留在凌霄仙舟一段时间，多接触了解一番，也未尝不可。
至于最终是否真的走到那一步。
自然还要看未来。
可至少现在，她并不抗拒。
另外…
方才姜夜，已经将陈归尘的真实身份告知了她。
那个一直以“夜尘”身份跟随在她身边的青年，实际上并非魔族，而是人族修士。
此人还是被魔界追查通缉之人。
姜族这些时日一直在寻找他的踪迹，而陈归尘却隐藏身份，潜入炎狱魔宫之中，甚至一直待在她的身边。
炎璃公主得知此事时，确实有些震惊。
她怎么也没有想到，自己竟然没有察觉。

这些日子以来，她虽然对夜尘有所欣赏，但更多的是看重他的忠诚与表现出的潜力，却从未想过，对方竟然一直隐藏着真正的身份。
这种隐瞒，让她心中不免生出几分不悦。
她并非因为对方是人族而厌恶。
魔族与人族之间虽然存在诸多恩怨，但炎璃并不是那种只看种族之人。
真正让她介意的是，陈归尘明明一直待在她身边，却从未主动透露真实来历。
一个人隐藏身份接近自己。
无论出于什么原因。
都意味着对方有所保留。
甚至可能别有所图！
对于这种人，她本来的感到不喜与厌恶。
像是被骗了一样。
而姜夜随后又透露了一点。
陈归尘身上，很可能藏着某种特殊的秘密，甚至疑似拥有能够预知未来的宝物。
这番话，让她心中顿时掀起了一丝波澜。
若真是如此。
那么她与陈归尘最初的相遇，恐怕也没有想象中那么简单。
content_en:
In Princess Yanli's heart, she actually did not reject Jiang Ye.
It can even be said.
The impression left on her by this godson of the Jiang clan was far better than she had initially expected.
Cultivation is strong.
Whether it was his speech and behavior, or his calmness when facing many powerful people in the demon world, Yanli felt a unique magnanimity.
Demons have always admired the strong.
This is especially true for Yanli.
Her personality is straightforward and decisive, and she has never liked those hypocritical temptations and tweaks.
Since Jiang Ye was interested, she didn't feel disgusted.
Instead, I felt that it would not be a bad idea to stay in Lingxiao Immortal Boat for a while and get to know more about it.
As for whether it really comes to that point in the end.
Of course, we still have to look at the future.
But at least now, she doesn't resist.
Also…
Jiang Ye had just informed her of Chen Guichen's true identity.
The young man who has been following her as "Ye Chen" is actually not a demon, but a human monk.
This person is still wanted by the demon world.
The Jiang clan has been looking for traces of him these days, but Chen Guichen hid his identity, sneaked into the Flame Hell Demon Palace, and even stayed by her side.
Princess Yanli was indeed shocked when she learned about this.
She never thought that she didn't notice it.
Over the past few days, although she had admired Ye Chen, she valued his loyalty and potential more, but she had never thought that he had been hiding his true identity.
This kind of concealment made her feel a little unhappy.
She was not disgusted because the other party was human.
Although there are many grievances between the demons and humans, Yanli is not the kind of person who only looks at race.
What really bothered her was that Chen Guichen had always been by her side, but he had never taken the initiative to reveal his true origins.
A person hides his identity and approaches himself.
Whatever the reason.
It all means that the other party has reservations.
You might even have ulterior motives!
She originally felt dislike and disgust for this kind of person.
It's like being lied to.
And Jiang Ye later revealed a little more.
Chen Guichen is likely to have some kind of special secret hidden in him, and he is even suspected of possessing a treasure that can predict the future.
These words immediately caused a wave of excitement in her heart.
If that's the case.
Then her initial encounter with Chen Guichen was probably not as simple as she imagined.
